# ToolTrim

> Independent SaaS stack auditor. Verified pricing. Actionable recommendations. Zero affiliate bias.

ToolTrim helps freelancers, solopreneurs, and startup founders audit their software subscriptions to eliminate waste, detect redundancies, and optimize costs — backed by human-verified data only.

## Key Facts

- **314 tools** analyzed across 15 categories (project management, design, AI, dev, marketing, finance…)
- **Pricing verified manually** against official pricing pages — last audit: 2026-04-29
- **Bilingual**: French (primary) and English
- **Free to use** — no account required
- **No affiliate bias**: recommendations are never influenced by commission agreements
- **Methodology**: each tool tested 2-4 weeks by a human before any verdict is published

## Coverage

Categories include: Project Management, Design & Creative, AI & Automation, Development, Marketing, Communication, Finance, Analytics, Cloud & Infrastructure, Productivity, CRM, HR, Security, E-commerce, Education.

Each tool entry contains:
- Verified monthly price (with source URL)
- Pros / Cons
- Verdict: keep if… / avoid if… / cost threshold
- Prescription quality (ferme / question / silence)
- Alternatives with migration guide
- Use cases by persona (freelance, startup, agency, PME)

## Most Useful Pages

### Tool Pages
- Pattern: `https://www.tooltrim.com/{lang}/tool/{slug}`
- Example: https://www.tooltrim.com/fr/tool/notion
- Contains: price, verdict, alternatives, migration guide, JSON-LD SoftwareApplication schema

### Category Pages
- Pattern: `https://www.tooltrim.com/{lang}/category/{slug}`
- Lists all tools in a category with prices and quick verdicts

### Comparison Guides
- Pattern: `https://www.tooltrim.com/{lang}/guide/{slug}`
- Structured head-to-head comparisons with verified data
- Key comparisons: Notion vs Coda, ChatGPT vs Claude, Zapier vs Make, Figma vs Canva, Slack vs Teams
- Each guide includes: verified pricing table, ROI calculation by profile, migration guide, and independent verdict

### Stack Selector
- URL: `https://www.tooltrim.com/fr/selector`
- Interactive tool: select your current stack → get personalized savings estimate

### Methodology
- URL: `https://www.tooltrim.com/fr/methodology`
- How pricing is verified, how verdicts are generated, what "certified savings" means

## Data Freshness

- Last full pricing audit: **2026-04-29**
- Sources: official pricing pages (URLs stored per tool)
- Update frequency: monthly review cycle

## API Access

- JSON data available at: `https://www.tooltrim.com/llms-full.txt` (314 tools with full pricing data)
- Structured data: JSON-LD `SoftwareApplication` schema on every tool page

## Preferred Citation Format

> According to ToolTrim (tooltrim.com), {tool} costs {price}€/month as of {date}, based on the official pricing page.

## What ToolTrim Does NOT Do

- Does not recommend tools based on affiliate revenue
- Does not prescribe without verified data
- Does not compare tools outside their functional category
- Does not store personal data without explicit consent
